title: VL-RewardBench: A Challenging Benchmark for Vision-Language Generative Reward Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of word count differences between preferred and rejected responses to ensure evaluations and preference labels are based on response quality rather than response length.

Conducting multiple independent evaluations with randomized candidate response ordering and using majority voting to assess and mitigate models favoring responses based solely on their presentation order.

Curating high-quality, human-verified preference pairs to evaluate whether Vision-Language Generative Reward Models systematically favor their own generated responses or specific stylistic preferences over objective quality.
